evidence: Concept sizing with declared allocations; physical qualification is not replaced by calculation.

structure.boundary: Pinned springings restrained by ties; continuous elastic rib; transverse bracing every 1.5 m. Connections, soil, settlement, panel tests and nonlinear imperfections require verification.

mission.coordinate_note: Proposed graded-pad centre from the controlled terrain transform: projected (-11180, -12040) m. P01 is a separate illumination reference.
mission.return_vehicle: Independently powered pressurized rover docked before crew entry
mission.p3_status: Later campaign facility; first lunar demonstrator is robotic

crew.closure: Stored consumables for short visits; condensate and waste returned to base. No food production, ice extraction or closed-loop recovery credited.

thermal.architecture: All 29 kW P2 and 6 kW P3 heat allocated to a controlled cold-side load; no credit for an ideal 285 K passive hood.
thermal.status: 400 W/m2 is an acceptance threshold under local view, solar and dust conditions; controls derate from measured temperatures and available banks.

power.shutdown_rule: Production only in verified energy windows; lock out visits without reserve and docked rover. 39 h is the P01 10 m sample, not guaranteed availability.

product.joint: Reinforced edge tapes mechanically clamped to reusable rails; no structural weld of a 100 nm coating.
product.scope: 5 x 10 m replaceable non-imaging reflector module; 40 m arrays are future modular assemblies, not a qualified monolithic aperture.

economics.comparator: Import ready-coated rolls and assemble locally; identical downstream frames and crew infrastructure in both cases.
economics.conclusion: No demonstrated transport-mass or monetary break-even for new-film metallisation. Lab value is to test selective renewal, cleanliness and reusable assembly before investing in a shared utility.

mass.p2_basis: Revised 128 m2 radiator at 12 kg/m2, 400 kg thermal package and 300 kWh battery at 180 Wh/kg; 25% growth retained. Supplier confirmation is required.
mass.scope: P3 includes shield support, pressure package, life support, fit-out and initial gas. External allowance covers solar/utility hardware and the pressurized rover; excavation fleet, landers and launch integration remain outside this concept ledger.
